package autochess

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/binary"
)

// Copies 为真实卡池张数（1/3/9），合星、出售、淘汰均按张数守恒。
type Unit struct{ Kind, Copies int }
type Command struct {
	Seq   uint64
	Epoch uint64
	Round int
	Kind  string
	A, B  int
}
type Receipt struct {
	Command     Command
	Gold, Round int
	Phase       string
}
type Seat struct {
	PlayerID                          int64
	Epoch                             uint64
	Connected, Ready, Locked, Claimed bool
	HP, Gold, Level, XP, Rank         int
	Shop                              [3]int
	Units                             [9]Unit
	Receipts                          []Receipt
}
type Fight struct {
	A, B, Winner, Damage int
	Boards               [2][3]Unit
}
type State struct {
	Schema           int
	Rules            Rules
	Seed             string
	Draw             uint64
	Phase            string
	Round            int
	Deadline, LastAt int64
	Pool             [3]int
	Seats            [Seats]Seat
	Fights           []Fight
}

// View 明确白名单：不包含种子、卡池余量、对手商店、备用席或指令账本。
type PublicSeat struct {
	PlayerID         int64
	HP, Rank         int
	Ready, Connected bool
	Board            [3]Unit
}
type View struct {
	Phase      string
	Round      int
	Deadline   int64
	ConfigHash string
	Players    [Seats]PublicSeat
	Self       SeatView
}
type SeatView struct {
	Epoch, NextSeq  uint64
	Gold, Level, XP int
	Locked, Claimed bool
	Shop            [3]int
	Units           [9]Unit
}

func (s State) View(id int64) (View, error) {
	i := s.Index(id)
	if i < 0 {
		return View{}, ErrRule
	}
	v := View{Phase: s.Phase, Round: s.Round, Deadline: s.Deadline, ConfigHash: s.Rules.Hash()}
	for j, p := range s.Seats {
		v.Players[j] = PublicSeat{PlayerID: p.PlayerID, HP: p.HP, Rank: p.Rank, Ready: p.Ready, Connected: p.Connected}
		copy(v.Players[j].Board[:], p.Units[:3])
	}
	p := s.Seats[i]
	v.Self = SeatView{p.Epoch, uint64(len(p.Receipts) + 1), p.Gold, p.Level, p.XP, p.Locked, p.Claimed, p.Shop, p.Units}
	return v, nil
}
func (s State) Index(id int64) int {
	for i, p := range s.Seats {
		if p.PlayerID == id {
			return i
		}
	}
	return -1
}
func New(ids [Seats]int64, r Rules, seed string, now int64) (State, error) {
	s := State{Schema: 1, Rules: r, Seed: seed, Phase: "prep", Round: 1, LastAt: now, Deadline: now + r.PrepMillis}
	if r.Validate() != nil || len(seed) != 64 || now <= 0 || now >= MaxTime {
		return State{}, ErrRule
	}
	for i, u := range r.Units {
		s.Pool[i] = u.Copies
	}
	for i, id := range ids {
		if id <= 0 {
			return State{}, ErrRule
		}
		for j := 0; j < i; j++ {
			if ids[j] == id {
				return State{}, ErrRule
			}
		}
		s.Seats[i] = Seat{PlayerID: id, Epoch: 1, Connected: true, HP: 6, Gold: 10, Level: 1}
		s.refresh(i)
	}
	return s, s.Validate()
}
func (s State) Encode() string { return encode(s) }
func Decode(raw string) (State, error) {
	var s State
	if e := strictJSON(raw, &s); e != nil {
		return s, e
	}
	return s, s.Validate()
}
func (s State) Validate() error {
	if s.Schema != 1 || s.Rules.Validate() != nil || len(s.Seed) != 64 || s.Round < 1 || s.Round > s.Rules.MaxRounds || s.LastAt <= 0 || s.LastAt >= MaxTime || s.Draw > 10000 {
		return ErrRule
	}
	if s.Phase != "prep" && s.Phase != "battle" && s.Phase != "done" {
		return ErrRule
	}
	if (s.Phase == "done" && s.Deadline != 0) || (s.Phase != "done" && (s.Deadline <= s.LastAt || s.Deadline >= MaxTime)) {
		return ErrRule
	}
	total := s.Pool
	ranks := map[int]bool{}
	for i, p := range s.Seats {
		if p.PlayerID <= 0 || s.Index(p.PlayerID) != i || p.Epoch == 0 || p.HP < 0 || p.HP > 6 || p.Gold < 0 || p.Gold > 1000 || p.Level < 1 || p.Level > 3 || p.XP < 0 || p.XP > 3 || p.Rank < 0 || p.Rank > Seats || len(p.Receipts) > LedgerLimit {
			return ErrRule
		}
		if p.Rank > 0 {
			if ranks[p.Rank] {
				return ErrRule
			}
			ranks[p.Rank] = true
		}
		if (s.Phase == "done" && p.Rank == 0) || (p.Claimed && s.Phase != "done") {
			return ErrRule
		}
		deployed := 0
		for j, u := range p.Units {
			if u.Copies == 0 {
				if u.Kind != 0 {
					return ErrRule
				}
				continue
			}
			if u.Kind < 1 || u.Kind > 3 || (u.Copies != 1 && u.Copies != 3 && u.Copies != 9) {
				return ErrRule
			}
			total[u.Kind-1] += u.Copies
			if j < 3 {
				deployed++
			}
		}
		if deployed > p.Level {
			return ErrRule
		}
		for _, k := range p.Shop {
			if k < 0 || k > 3 {
				return ErrRule
			}
			if k > 0 {
				total[k-1]++
			}
		}
		for j, r := range p.Receipts {
			if r.Command.Seq != uint64(j+1) || r.Command.Epoch == 0 || r.Command.Epoch > p.Epoch || r.Round < 1 || r.Round > s.Round {
				return ErrRule
			}
		}
	}
	for i, n := range total {
		if s.Pool[i] < 0 || n != s.Rules.Units[i].Copies {
			return ErrRule
		}
	}
	if len(s.Fights) > 4 || (s.Phase == "battle" && len(s.Fights) == 0) {
		return ErrRule
	}
	seen := map[int]bool{}
	for _, f := range s.Fights {
		if f.A < 0 || f.A >= Seats || f.B < -1 || f.B >= Seats || f.A == f.B || seen[f.A] {
			return ErrRule
		}
		seen[f.A] = true
		if f.B >= 0 {
			if seen[f.B] {
				return ErrRule
			}
			seen[f.B] = true
		}
		for _, board := range f.Boards {
			for _, u := range board {
				if u.Copies == 0 {
					if u.Kind != 0 {
						return ErrRule
					}
					continue
				}
				if u.Kind < 1 || u.Kind > 3 || (u.Copies != 1 && u.Copies != 3 && u.Copies != 9) {
					return ErrRule
				}
			}
		}
		if f.B < 0 {
			if f.Winner != f.A || f.Damage != 0 || f.Boards[1] != [3]Unit{} {
				return ErrRule
			}
		} else {
			w, d := Resolve(s.Rules, f)
			if w != f.Winner || d != f.Damage {
				return ErrRule
			}
		}
		if s.Phase == "battle" {
			for side, i := range []int{f.A, f.B} {
				if i < 0 {
					continue
				}
				if s.Seats[i].HP == 0 {
					return ErrRule
				}
				for j, u := range f.Boards[side] {
					if s.Seats[i].Units[j] != u {
						return ErrRule
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if s.Phase == "battle" {
		for i, p := range s.Seats {
			if p.HP > 0 && !seen[i] {
				return ErrRule
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func (s *State) returnShop(i int) {
	for j, k := range s.Seats[i].Shop {
		if k > 0 {
			s.Pool[k-1]++
			s.Seats[i].Shop[j] = 0
		}
	}
}
func (s *State) refresh(i int) {
	s.returnShop(i)
	for j := range s.Seats[i].Shop {
		total := s.Pool[0] + s.Pool[1] + s.Pool[2]
		if total == 0 {
			break
		}
		s.Draw++
		b := sha256.Sum256([]byte(s.Seed + encode(s.Draw)))
		n := int(binary.BigEndian.Uint64(b[:8]) % uint64(total))
		for k, c := range s.Pool {
			if n < c {
				s.Seats[i].Shop[j] = k + 1
				s.Pool[k]--
				break
			}
			n -= c
		}
	}
}
func (s *State) release(i int) {
	s.returnShop(i)
	for j, u := range s.Seats[i].Units {
		if u.Copies > 0 {
			s.Pool[u.Kind-1] += u.Copies
			s.Seats[i].Units[j] = Unit{}
		}
	}
}

// 三合一优先保留最前位置，满备用席拒绝购买；复制数不会凭空消失。
func (p *Seat) merge() {
	for _, n := range []int{1, 3} {
		for k := 1; k <= 3; k++ {
			for {
				idx := []int{}
				for j, u := range p.Units {
					if u.Kind == k && u.Copies == n {
						idx = append(idx, j)
					}
				}
				if len(idx) < 3 {
					break
				}
				p.Units[idx[0]].Copies = n * 3
				p.Units[idx[1]] = Unit{}
				p.Units[idx[2]] = Unit{}
			}
		}
	}
}
